sources.officialityEvidence: The current Government of Israel page, updated 26 March 2026, states that the Prevention of Infiltration law prohibits Israeli citizens from visiting five named destinations and makes a visit a criminal offense.

policies.title: Grenada: Israeli ordinary passports
policies.summary: Grenada's current Embassy schedule directly exempts Israeli visitors from an entry visa.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Israeli national passport for short visitor travel.
The schedule was revised in April 2024 and should be rechecked early if Grenada publishes a replacement.
Work, study, residence, special documents and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Ukraine: Israeli national passports
policies.summary: Ukraine's current treaty register marks the bilateral national-passport visa waiver in force.
conditions: Applies to a valid Israeli national passport for entry, exit, transit and a stay of up to 90 days within 180 days.
Work, residence, study and travel on documents outside the agreement remain separate.
